subject: MedicaHealth: reference video kickoff and production playbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Hammond <claire@medicahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MedicaHealth: reference video kickoff and production playbook

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a customer video with us. We really appreciate MedicaHealth making time. I wanted to send a compact plan so we all have alignment before we lock dates. High level:

- Format: 6–8 minute on-camera customer story (CEO + product manager soundbites), B-roll of the app/ops where possible.
- Options: on-site 2‑hour shoot at your HQ (preferred for B-roll) OR remote interview + submitted screen capture.
- Deliverables: final 6–8 min cut, 2 x 60s social edits, raw interview files for your archive.

Attached are: a one‑page release form we use, an initial call sheet, and a draft script/talking points. Please review the release — if legal needs changes, we’ll accommodate.

Next steps: can you confirm preferred format (on‑site vs remote) and 2 possible dates in August? Also who on your side should sign the release (name & title)?

I’ll coordinate logistics with Marissa (content) and Dylan (production).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RI_release_form_MedicaHealth_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: telehealth_shoot_call_sheet.xlsx]
[Attachment: medica_script_draft_v2.docx]

From: Claire Hammond <claire@medicahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedicaHealth Legal <legal@medicahealth.com>, MedicaHealth - Customer Success <cs@medicahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 12:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedicaHealth: reference video kickoff and production playbook

Hi Jonas —

Appreciate the clear plan. Good to have the attachments. A few quick notes from our side:

- Format: We’d prefer an on‑site shoot if possible — great for B‑roll — but our compliance team needs to review the release first.
- Signer: I will route the release to our legal counsel (Amir Patel, General Counsel). He typically requests a short usage window (2 years) and explicit data handling language for any applicant data shown.
- Dates: Aug 10–12 look workable for our marketing team; if you have flexibility we can lock one of those.

I’ll loop in Amir on the release review but feel free to send a version with the usage window and data language highlighted.

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Marketing, MedicaHealth

Marissa and Dylan — attaching the call sheet and script draft again. Marissa, can you confirm on‑camera questions and 3 core talking points we should surface? Dylan, if the team prefers Aug 10, we’ll plan travel for morning prep and a 1:00–4:00pm shoot window.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Claire Hammond <claire@medicahealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedicaHealth: reference video kickoff and production playbook — talking points

Hi all —

I reviewed the draft script and have trimmed it to be more conversational. Key proposed talking points (please comment):

1) Challenge: "Before Redwood, we were struggling with inference latency and inconsistent throughput during peak scheduling windows."
2) Outcome: "After integrating Redwood Inference, we saw a 3–4x improvement in response time and costs down ~35%."
3) Customer impact story: "A clinician anecdote about faster triage enabling same‑day consults."

On logistics:
- Call sheet updated for Aug 10 shoot: 12:00 load-in, 13:00 interview, 15:00 B-roll, 17:00 wrap.
- Wardrobe: business casual; please avoid bright patterns.
- Release: we can accept a 2‑year usage window; if legal asks for edits, send markup to me and I’ll escalate.

Claire — can you confirm spokespeople (name & title) and whether we can film one session on the operations floor? We’ll be mindful of PHI and won’t capture identifiable patient info — Dylan will coordinate safe B‑roll.

cheers,
Marissa
Director, Content Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: talking_points_marissa_v1.txt]

From: Claire Hammond <claire@medicahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedicaHealth Legal <legal@medicahealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedicaHealth: reference video kickoff and production playbook — signed release + final notes

Hi Marissa/Jonas —

Thanks for the updates and the clear talking points — these look good. Quick status:

- Legal has signed the release with the 2‑year usage window and an added paragraph clarifying that any patient imagery is strictly illustrative and will be simulated. Attached is the signed PDF.
- Spokespeople: I will appear on camera (Claire Hammond, Head of Marketing) and our Head of Product (Daniel Reyes). Both are confirmed for Aug 10.
- Ops floor: yes, you can capture B‑roll in the non‑clinical areas; Dylan, please coordinate arrival time for our facilities manager (Maya Singh) to escort you.
- Graphics: Please credit MedicaHealth in lower‑third and allow us to review final cut 5 business days prior to public release.

We’ve attached the signed release. Please confirm travel details and call time.

Best,
Claire
